creator: Alexander Terp
description: Each pane's environment carries MUSTER_DAEMON, the daemon executable's path, so agents can run muster-daemon report. The socket path is per install and stable, but an upgrade that moves the executable leaves long-lived panes pointing at a path that no longer exists, and their reports fail. Options: a stable launcher path per install, or resolving the executable through the socket.
title: MUSTER_DAEMON can name a vanished binary after an upgrade
